flavor.text: Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this Pokémon is very nimble and fleet.
It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.
The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.
There is no telling where the tail begins. Despite its short legs, it is quick and likes to chase RATTATA.
There is no telling where its tail begins. Despite its short legs, it is quick at hunting RATTATA.

It lives in narrow burrows that fit its slim body. The deeper the nests go, the more mazelike they become.

abilities.name: Run Away
abilities.description: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.description: The Pokémon's keen eyes prevent its accuracy from being lowered.

abilities.name: Frisk
abilities.description: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can check an opposing Pokémon's held item.
